data.description: The creature has a tail that ends in a snake head. This provides a +4 circumstance bonus on Perception checks and a primary bite attack (1d3 + the creature's Strength modifier for a Medium creature). In addition, the creature gains Improved Trip as a bonus feat.
data.name: Serpent-Headed Tail
